question: After the keyboard accessibility blocker is fixed, should this broad homepage facelift become the site’s new visual direction?
rationale: The branch intentionally changes nearly every homepage section and interaction pattern, so deterministic correctness cannot decide whether its hierarchy, density, and motion match the intended public-site direction.

options.title: Accept after accessibility review
options.body: Land the broad facelift once the focus defect is fixed and exact-head responsive and theme review confirms the final experience.

options.title: Narrow the facelift
options.body: Keep selected sections while splitting or reverting portions that do not fit the desired hierarchy or motion direction.

options.title: Pause the redesign
options.body: Retain the current homepage until a smaller or more explicitly directed redesign is ready.

recommendation.title: Accept after accessibility review
recommendation.body: Land the broad facelift once the focus defect is fixed and exact-head responsive and theme review confirms the final experience.
